tei:div.tei:p: (455)༄༅/ rab gnas bkra shis 'bebs phyag len rgyas par spro pa'i zur 'debs dge legs bdud rtsi'i sprin chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (456)

na mo gu ru bh+ya/ bkra shis bye ba'i chu 'dzin las/ bkra shis bdud rtsi'i gru char 'bebs/ bkra shis phan bde'i 'bras smin pa'i/ bkra shis mchog gi shis pa rtsol/ de la shes par bya ba'i gzhi rab gnas kyi ngo bo ni/ rten gang la sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan rnams bsdus nas dge zhing bkra shis pa'i don can du byed pa'o/ sgra don ni/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhabi dhi zhes pa'i sgras bzang por sgrub pa dang*/ yun ring du gnas par byed pa'i cho ga 'o/ gang la na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gtsug lag khang rgyan dang phyag mtshan sogs so/ dgos pa yang*/ gang du sku gzugs rab rdzogs pa// byin gyis ma brlabs ring gnas na// de la bkra mi shis pa 'byung*// de srid mchod par de mi 'os// zhes pa'i skyon las bzlog pa dang*// de nas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// dngos grub 'dod pas nan tan bya/ zhes pa'i phyir ro/ slob dpon yang phyi nang gsang ba'i de nyid bcu dang (457) ldan pas/ bkra shis pa'i gnas su gza' skar dus tshes bzang po la/ mdo rgyu dang*/ sgrub sde bka' brgyad lta bu'i dkyil 'khor chen po la brten nas bya ba ste/ de la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ dang po ni/ gang du bya ba'i gnas su dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i ras bris tshad ldan bting ba'i khar dbang bzhi'i chas dang*/ lha tsaka sogs tshang bar bsags nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mtha' bskor ba'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i g.yon ngos su/ khrus stegs gru bzhi pa'i steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su man+dzi la khrus gzhong me long dang bcas pa bshams/ 'dab ma brgyad la khrus bum kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa brgyad/ thun mong du dri'i chus sum gnyis bkang*/ khyad par shar bum nas brtsam te rim bzhin/ dri lnga/ mngar gsum/ zho gsar/ shing 'bras/ 'bru lnga/ 'bras yos/ sman lnga/ rin chen lnga rnams so sor blugs/ 'dag rdzas kyi snod bzhi yi dang por/

(458) cho ga dag pas sbyar ba'i ba byung lnga/ gnyis pa la/ zho/ 'o ma/ mar/ ka ra sbrang rtsi ste phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga/ gsum pa dri bzang dang*/ nye shing*/ shu te bzhi pa la/ skyu ru ra dang yung gi phye ma rnams blugs/ sku mnye'i til mar ram 'bru mar sil+la sogs kyi dri ldan/ dril phyis shun lpags lnga ni/ sangs rgyas thod par/ a shwar+ṭha dang n+ya gro ta// u dum+bā ra brka ti// bā la sha ste shing lnga las/ zhes bshad kyang rnyed dka' bas tsan+dan dkar po la 'o ma can gyi shing shun rung mthun bsres pa'i phye ma dang*/ sran dkar phye ma rnams snod gcig tu bkod/ so sor durba'i pir dang bcas pa/ de dag gi mtha' mchod pas bskor/ phyogs mtshams 'phan dang rgyal mtshan 'dzugs/ steng du gdugs dbub/ khrus dkyil gyi mdun du rin po che'i gzhong pa rab gnas me tog ser por bsgyur bas bkang ba'i dbus su gzungs bum dri'i chus bkang ba'i khar gser dngul lta ba'i me long la tsan+dan dkar po gur kum gi waṃ a ru ra rnams 'o mar sbyar nas rten 'brel snying po tshar bdun bris pa dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po/ gar kum/ a ka ru/ gla rtsi/ ga bur rnams bsres pa'i dri chu'i dung zhal/ kha tshar ma nyams pa'i khrus ras dri bzang gis sa bon lnga bris pa/ gos zung*/ sbyang chas mtheb kyu'i gtor ma gsum/ ting lo chang bu gsum/ gu gul/ yungs dkar/ 'bras zan nam gro zan gyi chang bu/ zho zan/ me (459) chu/ yungs dkar gsum dang*/ me chu til gsum/ de dag dor ba'i bzed zhal bcas nye bar bsdogs/ rtsa dkyil gyi g.yas su mnga' 'bul gyi maṇ+ḍal ri gling gi bkod pa bris pa'i dbus su zho dang mar bur gyi sbags pa'i tsa ru'i bza' ba zhal zas sha chang ma 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang pos bskor ba la mda' dar ser po gzugs/ de'i mtha' bskor du spyi dgos kyi mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma rnams dang*/ dbang po gsal byed kyi thur ma/ mnga' dbul chas/ rol mo'i khyad par sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/

de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod ni/ re zhig gter ma'i phyogs la mtshon na/ hriḥsngon bskal ma'i tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnams lan gsum gsum/ dkar gtor dang*/ bgegs gtor bsngo/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs rnams dang*/ ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyis bdag mdun dbyer med kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bskyed/ byin rlabs dbang skur spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa bstod pa bcas mthar chags su btang nas/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍal rtsa sngags dang phaṭaḥdzaḥ zhes pas dzabā khang dbye/ bdag mdun 'od zer (460) spro bsdu gzhung ltar gsal gdab nas bzlas pa dang*/ mjug tu rnam bum bsgrub pa ni/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du lha rnams dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la// 'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs// de dag sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas bum chur dbyer med ro gcig gyur/ zhes gzungs thag la 'jus te/ rtsa sngags kyi sham bur dbyangs gsal dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sbrel ba bzla zhing*/ mthar mchod bstod dang*/ lha 'od du zhu bas bum chu bdud rtsir gyur/ zhes brjod/ las bum sgrub pa ni/ 'phags pa mig mi 'dzum pa chags med rin po che'i gzhung dngos las/ swa bha wa= las bum mi dmigs pa las sogs nas/ sngags la a mṛ ta brgya tsam bzla/ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod pa dang*/ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las me tog la gnas pa'i gzungs bum dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa'i khrus bum rnams bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel zhing mchu 'phyang ba/(461)lha'i gos pañtsa li ka'i mgul chings dang*/

dpag bsam shing gis kha rgyan can sha stag gi gzungs bum nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rten 'brel snying po'i sngags phreng 'od dang 'od zer du 'bar bas 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud bsdu ba dang*/ khrus bum rnams su'ang zla ba'i steng na rang rang gi sngags rnams 'od zer 'phro zhing*/ dri ma sbyong ba'i mthu ldan gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsam la/ las rdor gyis gzungs bum me long khar bzhag pa'i gzungs thag sne slob dpon la phul zhing*/ ye dharma brgya rtsa bzlas/ slar bskul mtshams byas nas ye dharma nyer gcig bzlas skabs dung zhal gyi chus me long gi rten snying gzungs bum nang du bkru/ slar gzungs bum chu dung zhal du cung zad blugs pa gtso bum/ las bum/ khrus bum brgyad/ me tog bcas la thig re blugs las rdor gyis bzungs thag khrus bum brgyad kyi nang shar gyi bum pa'i khar bzhag nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe dz+nyā na pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun/ de nas gzungs thag shar lho sogs g.yas bskor du spo zhing*/ sngags thog mtha' 'dra ba la gan+dhe'i gnas su (462)tri ma dhu snā na= da dhi= pha la= bru hi= la dzā= o ṣa dhi= ma ṇi= zhes sbyar ba rnams tshar bdun re/ gzungs thag shar bum kho na'i steng bzhag ste/ gzhung gi sngags ṣe ka te brgya rtsa/ spyan ma'i sngags/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swa hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig brtan par bya ba'i don du rdor sems yig brgya bdun/ las thogs med 'grub pa'i don du rten 'brel snying po lan bdun/ dung zhal gyi dri chu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nyer gcig gu gul yungs dkar gral bskor bya zhing*/ yungs dkar khro bo'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ a bigh+naṃ ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

nyer gcig hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags nyer gcig gis brlabs so/ de nas dkyil 'khor gang la brten pa'i bdag 'jug blang sta ེ/ ji ltar bltam pa'i sogs khrus dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi'i bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol gdab nas/ gtso bos ji ltar dang*/ btang rag maṇ+ḍal yan bya'o/ las rdor gyis gral gshams nas phyag gsum/ zhwa lag tu bzung nas/ kye dus gsum rgyal ba= sogs gzhung ltar gsol gdab lan gsum/ spro na cha gsum mam/ dkar gtor lha klu gnod sbyin tsam btang*/ 'di nas thams cad kyi zhwa chos bzhes/ las rdor pas phyag gsum/ zhwa lag tu (463)thogs nas/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la zhi ba'i sgo nas sbyong ba gnang bar zhu/ de 'khral zhwa gyon la lag g.yas kyis zhi sbyong g.yas bskor lan gsum gyis bzed zhal du bzhag pa dang*/ thams cad kyis rdor dril bcas pad skor mdzod rgya se gol kyi phyag rgya bcas/ gzhung gi oṃ sarba big+nan sogs sngags lan gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten= sogs nas/ dengs shig bar/ las rdor pas zhwa phab nas/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la zhi drag phyed ma'i sgo nas sbyong ba gnang bar zhu/ zhwa gyon nas ting lo chang bu'i rdzas zhi ba g.yon bskor gsum gyis bzed zhal du dor ba dang*/ sngags drag po oṃ sum+bha ni lan gsum la thams cad kyi rdo rje bskor/ dril bu bsil/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten= sogs 'gyur ro bar las rdor pas zhwa phab ste/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la drag sngags kyi sgo nas sbyong ba gnang bar zhu/ zhes zhu zhwa phrag khyer gyis spos thur 'gyed/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i nang du rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa 'jigs su rung ba'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum yi (464)ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas bgegs kyi dgra bo khro bo'i sprin rab 'byams badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

rdor dril spos bcas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sregs// zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag sham can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje nang 'dren bcas zhi rol sbir/ las rdor gyis spos bsdu/ khro bo'i nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa pā ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rol mo ḍa ma ru bcas btang*/ rdor dril bcas gzhung gi/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra= sogs nas gdon mi za/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ las gzhung gang la bya ba'i bka' bsgo'i 'og rol chen mtshams rngams kyi 'og tu las rdor gyis zhwa gyon sbyang gtor phyir spo theng gsum gyi mthar rgyab tu dor/ gu gul dang bdud rtsi lnga'i dud pas rten la bdug slob dpon lha khang thams cad la bgegs bskrad du phebs/ phyir phebs grub (465) nas gzhung gi mtshams gcod btang*/ zhwa chos bzhag las rdor gyis phyag gsum zhwa lag tu thogs nas/ gnas bya'i rten dang bdag cag yon mchod kyi byur dang skal pa ngan pa sbyong ba la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes brjod nas zhwa gyon/ lag g.yas gro zan dang*/ g.yon zho zan chang bas rten la g.yas bskor gyi tshul byed tshe/ byang 'dren gyis bskul nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bzed zhal du dor/ yang lag gnyis khu tshur gyen bstan gyis yungs dkar bzung ba g.yon du bskor skabs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swa hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dang pos mer bsregs/ gnyis pas chur dor/ gsum pas me chu gnyis dor/ yang lag gnyis kas chu snod bzung ste g.yas bskor ba'i tshul byed skabs/

oṃ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swa hā/ zhes tshar gcig gis me theb tu blugs/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ= sogs tshar gcig gis me chu gnyis ka snga ma'i bzed zhal du blugs nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas rab tu gnas bya'i rten dang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams la mi shis par byed pa'i byur dang skal ba ngan (466)pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hā/ zhes pa rol mo'i skabs phyir dor/ las rdor phyag dang zhwa phab nas/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i sdig pa sbyong ba la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes brjod nas/ zhwa gyon nas lag g.yas g.yon gyis til nag bzung la/ gzhung las/ snying gar kaṃ las= sogs nas sngags lan gsum dus g.yas g.yon lan gsum gsum du bskor ba'i mthar me chu dor ba lan gsum mthar/ g.yas su ye shes= sogs mthar rol 'og phyir dor/ de nas khrus bya ba la/ thams cad zhwa chos bcas bzhengs*/ las rdor gyis khrus dar phrag g.yon dang lag g.yon me long thogs la khrus dkyil mdun du 'khod/ de'i mar me dang spos sbar/ las rdor gyi g.yas su 'dag chas dang so pir bcas dang*/ khrus bum phyi ma 'dzin pa phrag par gos zung bkal ba/ g.yon du bsku mnye pir bcas thogs pa'i grogs dan pa gnyis kyang 'khod de/ byang 'dren pas bskul/ gzhung gi bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa= sogs nas/ rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ sngags zhi rol dang bcas snyan gsan dbab pa la khrus chu mi blugs/ stong gsum kun tu= sogs nas byug par bgyi/ 'dag chal dang ba byung lnga durba'i pir gyis me long la byug cing*/ a mrita kuṇ+ḍa la ི'i las sngags bzla/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hriḥ(467)āḥ zhes 'bru mar gyis bsku mnye bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ka ya bi shwa dha ni swa hā/ zhes shing shun lnga yi phye mas dril phyis bya/ las bum thogs pas gzhung gi khro chen bdud rtsi= sogs dang*/ sngags rol mo/

khrus ras kyis phyi zhing*/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i= sogs/ shwa dha ni swa hā/ de'i 'gres kyi khrus bya dgos pas/ stong gsum kun tu= 'dag chal snga ma ldab la las sngags a mṛta/ bsku mnye/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ dril phyis/ ka ya bhi= rnams dang*/ khrus bum dang pos/ ji ltar = 'di ni= rgyal ba'i= mtshams su rol mo/ khrus dang po'i dri'i bum pa 'di mdun du bzung la 'og ma rnams nas thig pa re blugs so/ rgyal dang= sogs sku phyi/ stong gsum= sogs 'dag chas snga ma ldab/ bsku mnye/ dril phyis rnams sngags bcas gong ltar thams cad la btang dgos/ bum pa gnyis pas/ ri bo ltar ni= sogs le tshan bdun/ mtshams rnams su zhi rol 'gre/ rgyal dang= sogs sku phyi/ stong gsum= sogs 'dag chal gnyis pa phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga byug bsku mnye/ dril phyis/ bum pa gsum pas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i= sku phyi/ rgyal dang= sogs dang*/ 'dag chal ldab cing*/ bsku mnye (468) dril phyis/ bum pa bzhi pas/

'di ni tshul khrims= sku phyi/ 'dag chal gsum pa dri bzang dang nye shing byug bsku mnye/ dril phyis/ bum pa lnga pas/ 'di ni bzod pa'i= sku phyi/ 'dag chal ldab/ bsku mnye/ dril phyis/ bum pa drug pas/ 'di ni brtson 'grus= ska ུ phyi/ 'dag chal bzhi ba skyu ru ra sogs byugs/ sku mnye/ dril phyis/ bum pa bdun pas/ 'di ni bsam gtan= sku phyi/ 'dag chal yang 'gro/ bsku mnye/ dril phyis/ bum pa brgyad pas/ 'di shes rab= sku phyi 'dag chal bzhi pa byugs/ bsku mnye/ dril phyis/ bum pa brgyad ka'i chu phyogs gcig dril ba'i shar bum gyis khrus bya zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa= dang*/ ston mchog dam pa= 'di man gyi khrus thams cad las mtshams rnams su rol mo btang dgos/ rgyal dang*/ sku phyi ras dkar la dung zhal gyi dri lnga'i chus thig le bkod/ gos dang rgyan 'bul ba/ srab 'jam= sogs nas/ brgyan par shog bar/ skabs 'dir shis brjod spro na 'og gi phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs brjod/ rol mo sbir/ 'di mtshams lha khang kun la lha khrus phebs/ phyir 'khor nas thams cad kyis zhwa chos phud la rang gral du 'khod/ rten (469) bskyed pa ni sgrub dkyil gang la brten pa'i mdun bskyed ltar ram/ bye brag tu bskyed na/ swa bha wa/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa chen po'i ngang las rab tu gnas bya'i rten sku gzugs dang mchod rten gtsug lag khang dang skyed mos tshal la sogs pa oṃ paṃ oṃ las seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ paṃ a raṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du oṃ dzi na dzika lam de shwa ra te rnam snang dkar bo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen g.yon gsum dril bu pad+ma ral gri 'dzin pa/ spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ lung gi chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i glegs bam gyi rnam pa can rnams hri maṃ hrī las rma bya'i khri la paṃ a raṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du aṃ a ro lika

paṃ ra ga ra ti snang ba mtha' yas dmar po dkar dmar sngo ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa (470)gos dkar mo pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rtogs pa'i chos dang 'bras bu'i ye shes thugs phyag mtshan gyi brda dang rnam par grub pa rnams hūm̐ gaṃ hūm̐ las glang po che'i khri/ paṃ a las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rika muṃ dhā te shwa ri mi bskyod pa sngon po mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ g.yon gsum dril bu pad+ma ral gri/ dbyings phyug ma sngon mo rdor dril 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ de thams cad kyang zhi ba'i tshul dgu dang rin po che'i rgyan cha bcu gsum gyis mdzes pa'i mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas shing 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal chen por bzhugs pa'o/ de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ bdag dang rten gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes bsdu rgya dang*/ las rdor gyis spos reng 'gyed/ thams cad zhwa chos bcas bzhengs/ rdor dril spos bcas dbyangs shin tu ring pos/ gzhung gi ma lus sems can (471) sogs mthar rol mo ring por btang nas gral du bzhugs/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bzed zhal dang*/ phyag tu dung chu phul la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni= sogs kyi tshig bstun bzed zhal du mchod yon sbrengs/ zhwa phud/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ ar+ghaṃ= sa ོgas nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rol mo sbir/ 'gugs gzhugs bya ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ho/ zhes sems dpa'i phyag rgya bcings/

rgyas gdab pa ni rang rang gi phyag rgya brten gyi gnas gsum du ba bzhag la/ 'og gi rten rnams kyi spyi bor 'khor lo'i lte bar= sogs nas rgyas gdab par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐/ skal ldan sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi sku// deng 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs su rgyas gdab bo/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ de bzhin du kā ya'i gnas su/ wāk+ka dang*/ tsit+ta yang sbyar/ dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gis lha mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs kyis (472) mchod/ rol mo bsgrags/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sa bstod/ thal sbyar gyis/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyobs pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs shing mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa'i las mdzad nas/ rgyal tshab kyis mngon par dbang bskur bar gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ma lus sems can bskyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog gi bkra shis shog zhes me tog 'thor/ bla ma la gtso bum phul/ bsta gon la zhal nang*/ dngos gzhi la phyir phyogs nas 'dzin/ gzhan rnams dril bcas/ ji ltar bltam pa tsam gyis ni/(473)/de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yis chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/

zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i dba' rlabs spyi bor brtan pa las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ rigs dbang thams cad kyi bdag nyid dbu rgyan bzung la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.a rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ oṃ truṃ/ zhes rdo rje bka' nan gyi go bsgo/ oṃ badz+ra tuṣ+ya ho/ zhes thal mos mnyes par byas/ mchod bstod bzlas pa ni/ mchod rdzas rnams/ las sngags dang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang*// bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du// oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin// so so'i lha mo'i rol pa bcas// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ a hūm̐/ nas (474)shab+ta'i bar/ rol mo/ las gzhung gi mchod pa'am/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i mchod phreng ni/ mchog gi me tog 'di dag ni// chu dang thang las de bzhin skyes// mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*// mchog gi bdug pa 'di dag ni// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*// mchog tu gyur pa'i dri 'di ni// mchog gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes// mun pa 'joms byed snang ba'i mchog /mar dang til gyi mar me 'di// yang dag ye shes dbye bya'i phyir// dad pas bdag gis 'bul bar bgyi// gza' dang btung ba phun sum tshogs/ kha dog dri ro rnams dang ldan/ thams cad ldan pa lha yi bshos// bdag gis dbul gyis so sor bzhes/ puṣ+pe= sogs kyis mchod/ rol mo/ bstod pa ni/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du= sogs shwa lo ka dang*/ rgyud las (475)

byung ba/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa rnams// thugs rje'i thabs dang shes rab grur bcug ste// zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon de la kun nas 'dud// sems can las kyi chu bor nub gyur rnams// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' (476)bdag khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes pas bstod/ gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rten so so'i rnam par byon nas de la zhugs par gyur/ zhes dang*/ dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i lha snyen sum brgya tsam dang*/ sku gzugs la su pra tiṣ+ṭha brgya rtsa dang*/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang la/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ khaṃ badz+ri bha wa dṛ dha tiṣ+ṭa bhu khaṃ swa hā/ zhes pa lnga bcu tsam dang*/ gsung rten la gnyis ka dang*/ thun mong du/ ye dharmā brgya rtsa tsam bzla'o/ gtor ma btang ba ni/ bka' gter srung ma spyi dang*/ bye brag dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i sger srung rnams kyi gtor chog rnams dang*/ sngar ma song na cha gsum gtor ma yang skabs 'di nyid du bya'o/ las gzhung gi tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstab yan 'dir bya ba rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes yin no/

las rdor gyis spos reng 'gyed cing*/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs/ rdor dril spos bcas snyan gsan dbab cing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hāḥ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer mos la/ oṃ sa (477)ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya haṃ/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs brnyan 'dir bzhugs shig /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni// ci 'byor ba yi mchod pa rnams// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ rjes su brtse bas dgongs su gsol// kun gyis 'di la byin rlabs shing*// de nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ zhes pa lan gcig grub pa dang spos bsdu/ zhwa bcas bzhengs la/ gzhung gi bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa= sa ོgas dang*/ rol mo dang bcas lan gsum/ zhwa phab gral du bzhugs gong du bshad ma thag pa'i mchod pa byin brlabs dang*/ mchod phreng*/ bstod pa bcas 'dir bskyar la btang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub rtsol/(478)sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang sems ma rdo rje ma'i rgya thar ldog spyi bor bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muṃ/ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha/ rten gyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ slar yang*/ me tog dam pa sa mchod/ de dag bsngags pa sa bstod/ rten dgab pa ni/ rten gyi gnas gsum du dri dang thig le byugs zhing*/ gzhung gi hūm̐/ bar mdzes dri med= sogs nas dhī pa pra pu ye swa hā/ zhes dang las sngags bzla/ rdo rjes reg nas/ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes bsrung bar bya/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dbyings su bsrung bar bsam la/

oṃ badz+ra tsakra wārti bh+rūm̐/ zhes dang ser pos dgab la/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ skabs 'di tsam du sang nyin rgyas pa'i sbyin bsregs blugs pa'i sa chog thig tshon sogs gsang ba'i bdag po mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ljags bsgrigs bzhin bya'o/ nang du log nas lha tshom bkod/ de nas las gzhung tshogs drangs ba lhag ma/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ chad brtan man chad rjes chog mthar dbyung bas nyin dang po sta gon nam lhag gnas kyi cho ga grub pa'o/ ༈ nyin gnyis par dngos gzhi la/ bdag mdun (479) sgrub mchod/ bum pa sgrub pa/ bdag 'jug blang ba/ sbyong ba rnams dang*/ khrus gsol tshang ma shis brjod bcas grub pa'i rjes su/ zhwa bcas bzhengs bzhin tu las rdor gyis nas 'gyed/ gzhung gi gsol gdab la/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa= sogs dang*/ me tog 'thor rol/ mo bcas lan gsum/ gsum par/ byon nas kyang= sogs sbyar/ zhwa phud/ gral du 'khod/ sngags ring lan bdun dang*/ yi dam bsnyen pa nyer gcig sems bskyed pa ni/ zur byang gi ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa/ sogs/ thams cad kyis pus mo g.yas pa phab/ me tog thogs cing lhan cig tu 'don nas/ gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang me tog 'thor/ de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i/ swa bha wa= phyi nang gi chos thams cad= sogs nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ 'dir spyan 'dren gyi mal du spro na rig 'dzin byin 'bebs btang bar gsungs so/ bsdu na spyan 'dren rang gis mthus/ gang ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'dir ni= stong gsum kun dang= pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas 'gugs gzhug rgyas gdab/ at+ma ko3 haṃ/ bar sta (480) gon bzhin/ de nas gzhung gi oṃ na mo bud+dha ya= sogs lan gsum mam bdun rol mo dang bcas me tog 'thor/ zhwa bcas bzhengs la/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs nas gnyis su med par gyur/ ra ོla mo bcas/

zhwa phud/ gral la bzhugs/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni cho ga gang la brtan pa shes par bya ba'am/ mi nus na las rdor gyis phyag gsum/ sa gzhi spos chus ma'i maṇ+ḍal dang*/ gzhung gi kyai/ bla ma sku gsum= sogs zhu nas/ gong du sta gon skabs kyi dbang bskur ba/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon= sogs nas dbang bskur mchog gi bkra shis shog zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa btegs la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po che/ khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pas// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ hūm̐/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed pa'i// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan sku yi dbang bskur ro/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥbadz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbu rgyan bzung la/ hūm̐/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs nga rgyal (481)sbyong byed pa'i// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi// dpal ldan yon tan dbang bskur ro/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃḥ

rdo rje bzung la/ hūm̐/ 'du shes phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa'i// so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ dril bu bzung la/ hūm̐/ 'du byed phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed cing*// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan phrin las dbang bskur ro/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rdor dril spyi bor 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ rnam shes phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa'i// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi// dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi+u ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ gnas bya'i lha thams cad rang rang gi rigs kyi gzungs ma dang 'khril bas dam tshig gsum dang du bzhes par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*/(482)/snang stong dbyer med 'di bzung la// snang stong snying rje'i snying po yi// kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis// 'gro kun rjes su bzung bar mdzod/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ zhes dril bu 'khrol zhing dkur rten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ slar mtha' brten bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba ni/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams dbang gi bya ba la dgyes pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba yongs su bzung ste dbang bskur bar gyur/ gzhung gi hūm̐/ dri med bum pa'i gzhal yas na// yi dam rgyal ba'i lha tshogs= sogs nas hūm̐ swa hā 'i bar dang*/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dag bya ma lus pa sbyangs/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu rgyan/ nam mkha'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin du rten la thim par gyur/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swa hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ gsang dbang ni/ (483)dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas nyi zla byang chub sems kyi sprin rdo rje'i ljags la spro bar mos la/ hūm̐/ dga' ba byang chub sems chen po// kun tu tshims par byed pa yi// dkar dmar lhag pa'i byang chub sems// dbang thob khyed kyi lce la bzhag a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ shes rab ye shes ni/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs ka nas thar pa bsten pa la bskul ba'i rig ma gzugs dang lang tsho'i dpal gyis 'byor pa du ma byon nas gnas bya'i lha tshogs rnams kyi pang du byon pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes la rol pa mdzad par bsam ste/ rig tsaka gam dril bu bzung la/ khyer cig khyer cig bde ba can// shes rab dam pa 'di yin no/ khyod kyis ye shes bskyed par byed// 'di la rtag tu rol mo gyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid chen po byang sems kyi dbang la bskur bya skur byed kyi rgyu 'bras dag par bsam la/ chos rnams thams cad nam mkha'i khams// dngos po (484)mtshan ma kun las 'das// nam mkha' bzhin du ye gnas la// de la mkhas pas bcos su med/ ca ེsa mnyam par bzhag de nas mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams ste/ bstod pa'i bar gong du sta gon skabs su bshad pa bzhin 'dir yang bskyar la btang ngo*/ dbang po'i skyon bsal ba ni/ dngul snod du mar dkar dang sbrang rtsi/ ka ra/ nir ma li la sogs pa'i mig sman sbyangs pa gser thur gyis blangs pa thogs pas/ gzhung gi kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan= sogs nas shwa dha ni swa hā 'i bar dang*/ 'og gi nye ring mi mnga' kun tu gsal/ zhes pa nas/ dan+ta shwa dha ni a hūm̐ swa ha 'a'i bar 'di blang*/ de la 'dod yon lngas mchod pa ni/ oṃ ru pa pra tits+tsha a hūm̐/ shab+ta

ghan+dhe rā sa spar+she pra tits+tsha a hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rten bsgyur ba ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mos rten gyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long la reg cing se gol gyis sgras mtshon pa gnas bya'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā/ lan gsum brjod la/ gzhung gi mgon po skal ba ji bzhin= sogs nas don kun mdzod/ zhes dang*/ rigs kyis mtshon (485)pa'i lha yi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ ces brjod/ rab tu gnas pa ni/ rten la gzungs thag btags pa'i sne slob dpon gyis bzung la/ gong du bshad pa'i/ gnas bya'i rten rnams thugs kar zla ba la= sogs dang*/ bzlas pa rnams grangs snga nyin ltar la/ rten snying bzlas pa'i bar 'dir blangs la/ sngar gzungs bum chus bran pa'i me tog 'thor zhing*/ zhwa chos bcas bzhengs la/ gzhung gi bkra shis/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sh+lau ka gsum dang*/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ ye dharma he tu= sogs bzla/ rol mo sgrags shing phyogs kun tu 'thor nas kyi ched du phebs/ tshur 'khor nas zhwa chos bzhag la bzhugs/ me tog dam pa phreng ba= sogs sh+lo ka gnyis pos mchod/ rol mo/ rten gyi khri'am/ de la me tog gi phreng ba btags la bzung ste/ thal mo sbyar nas/ ji srid sa chu me dang ni// rlung gi bskal pas 'jig bar du// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod// 'di ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang (486)phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gzhung gi phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang= sogs nas le tshan gnyis lan gsum dang bcas/ brten par bzhugs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de nas mnga' 'bul ba ni/ las byang gang la brten pa'i mchod rdzas byin rlabs/ rol mo bcas btang*/

de nas dbyangs phyag rgya dang bcas/ gzhung gi/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med= sogs nas/ mtshams rnams su rol mo bsgrags/ nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rig ma bcu drug ni/ kun tu dga' ba nyams bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can// rdo rje pi waṃ gling bu rnga thabs bzung*// yid 'phrog 'jo sgeg ldan pa'i lang tsho ma// nam mkha' rab 'byams gang bas 'khor lor mchod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra wa ṇa hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ waṃ se trāṃ/ mṛ taṃ gi hrīḥ mu ra dze āḥ mchog tu dga' ba nyams bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can// rdo rje sgeg bzhad glu dang gar mkhan ma// yid 'phrog 'jo sgeg ldan pa'i lang tsho ma// nam mkha' rab 'byams gang bas 'khor lor mchod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra (487)la s+ya hūm̐/ ma l+ya trāṃ/ gīrti hrīḥ nirti āḥ khyad par dga' ba nyams bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab ma/ yid 'phrog= nam mkha'= oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ dhu pe traṃ/ ā lo ke hrīḥ gan+dhe āḥ lhan skyes dga' ba nyams bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can// gzugs reg ro dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma// yid 'phrog= nam mkha'= oṃ āḥbadz+ra ru pa hūm̐/ rā sa trāṃ/ spar+she hrīḥ dharma dhā tu āḥ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud sde gong ma'i lha rnams la las gzhung gi sman raka gtor ma sbyor sgrol de kho na bcas pas mchod do/ bstod pa ni/ gzhung gi mnyam med mi g.yo= sogs la/ rten so so'i dgos bstod ci rigs sbyar nas/ mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/ zhes dang*/ las rdor zhwa chos bcas maṇ+ḍal nas brtsam/ mnga' 'bul rdzas rnams rdor slob mdun du bzhag pa/ slob dpon gyis so sor 'bul tshul bcas tshur gnang 'phral mnga' 'bul dkyil 'khor mthar shar nas g.yas bskor 'khod cing*/ gzhung gi sa gzhi spos chus= sogs nas a pa na āḥ(488)hūm̐ swa hā 'i bar dang*/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing= sogs nas glegs thag 'bul ba yan chad rdzogs par btang*/

de nas rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin skabs 'di nyid du bya zhing*/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa mchod pa'i snga rol gzhal yas dang gdan bskyed pa la rab tu gnas pa'i lha rnams me tog gis mtshon par thab tu spyan drangs nas mchod/ slar rten gyi thugs kar gshegs pa tsam dmigs bsal dang*/ sbyin bsreg grub pa'i me long la snod bzang por/ 'o ma dang*/ 'bras ma grum pa/ mar sbrang/ ka ra rnams rang gi 'dod lha'i sa bon las byung bar bsam pa'i 'o thug sbyin bsreg gi thab tu mañdzi'i khar bkol/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor gyis rdzas lnga po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bltas la/ oṃ di be an+ti sa ma dhi dh+ya na shri' ṇa ye swa hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang*/ las gzhung gis rtsa bsnyen brgya rtsa sogs kyis bsgrubs nas/ yar phebs/ las rdor zhwa bcas tsa ru'i zhal zas chen mo dang*/ grogs dan pas zhwa bcas 'o thug btegs/ thams cad nas phyag rgya bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo= sogs lan gsum dang*/ zhal zas ro brgya= sogs/ hūm̐ swa hā 'i bar dang*/ las gzhung gi tshogs byin rlabs nas/ sgral bstab (489) yan skabs 'dir bya'o/ 'dir spro na dgongs 'dus rab gnas bkra shis brtsegs pa las byung ba'i 'dod gsol/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa= sogs bla mas gsungs zhing 'dus pa rnams kyi mthun 'gyur gnang*/ bzlas pa'i mnga' 'bul ni/ rten gtsor gzungs thag btags pa'i sne nas bzung ste/ gong du bshad pa'i/ gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi thugs dkar zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags phreng= sogs dang*/ ye dhar brgya rtsa dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brgya rtsa tsam dang*/ bh+rūm̐ khaṃ= sogs lnga bcu tsam bzla zhing*/ rten de nyid las= sogs kyi mtshams rnams su ye dharma bdun ra tsem bzla nas/ mngon spyod kyi phrin las 'grub bo/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ slar yang sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa'i mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/

rab gnas kyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i mchod phreng dang bstod pas kyang bstod/ bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba/ zhwa bcas/ ye dharma= phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba 'i shis brjod/ rol mo bcas bya/ zhwa phud/ de nas rtsa gsum dang*/ bka' gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag gi gtor chog cha gsum rnams dang*/ tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma/ chad brtan nas cho ga'i rjes chog rnams mthar chags su btang bas dngos gzhi grub bo// (490)༈ nyin gsum pa rjes chog la/ bdag mdun dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ gtso las kyi bum sgrub bdag 'jug bcas grub nas/ las gzhung gi tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstab yan grub pa dang*/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gong du sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa'i/ gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i= sogs dang*/ bzlas grangs bcas nyin snga ma rnams ltar la/ ye dhar bzlas zin nas/ thams cad stong nyid kyi mchod pa byin brlabs dang*/ rab gnas rgyud las byung ba'i mchod bstod bcas sta gon skabs ltar bya/ dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar/ ji srid sa chu me rlung sogs dang*/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs dang/ gzhung gi phyogs bcu na= sogs me tshan gnyis bcas lan gsum brjod/ de nas bla ma yi dam gtor 'bul dang*/ bka' gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag gnas gzhi'i srung ma dang*/ sgos su gnyer gtad dmigs bsal bya na de'i gtor chog bcas rgyas par btang*/ phyi rol du cha gsum bcas bya/ nang du log nas gzhung gi gnyer gtad/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i= sogs nas las rdor gyis zhwa bcas gta' gtor btegs shing mthar rten gyi drung du rten la phyogs par bzhag dgos la/ (491)rtag tu srung dang skyobs par mdzod/ zhes pa'i mtshams su 'og gi badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ rdo rje 'di ni = sogs nas hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes pa dang*/ chos sku kun tu bzang po nas drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las mi 'da' bar=

sogs tshig gshams gzhung ltar sbrel nas/ phrin las spel cig zhes dang*/ gong gi na mo sangs rgyas chos dang= sogs nas skyobs cig phrin las spel cig zhes pa'i bar brjod/ 'di skabs las gzhung gi tshogs mi drang*/ lhag ma btang*/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ las byang gi thugs dam bskul pa/ chos skyong gi gtor skyong*/ chad tho/ brtan ma/ rta bro yan rdzogs par btang*/ de nas lha gzhung la brten pa de'i mchod pa byin rlabs/ phyi mchod/ bstod pa bcas rgyas par bya/ nongs bshags ni brjod med don bshags dang*/ gzhung gi rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// gang dag cho ga bya ba la// 'gal zhing 'khrul pa gang mchis dang*// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa (492)rnams// nongs par gyur pa gang lags te/ kun tu bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang dbyangs gsal yig brgya sbrel ba lan gsum brjod/ de nas zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gsung rab las byung ba bzhin skabs 'di nyid du bya'o// slar nang du log nas mdun bskyed kyi ye shes rten la bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdus la/ bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu ba dang*/ rjes thob lha skur ldang zhing go bsgo lus bsrung rnams las gzhung gang la brten pa ltar bya'o/ de nas yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams 'du bya/ de dang nye bar rten bzang po me tog gi tshom bu can la yon bdag gos rgyan bzang po byas la 'khod/ sbyin bdag mdun gcog stegs la chu gnyis nyer spyod bkod/ thams cad kyi bsam lhun sogs gsungs zin nas/ slob dpon gyis yon bdag bsgo ba'i gtong thun ni/ de yang 'di ltar sbyin pa'i bdag pos lhag pa'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba rnam par dag pas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs shing rab tu gnas par gsol ba 'di ni dge legs kyi gzhir gyur pa yin te/

spyir lha dang bcas (493)pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi phan pa dang bde ba ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na la rag las shing*/ de yang dkon mchog gi rten la rag las pa dang*/ khyad par bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyar byin gyis brlabs nas gdul bya thun mong ba rnams la'ang dbang po'i mngon sum du snang bas bsod nams kyi zhing brten sla ba'i phyir de dag sgrub tshul dang*/ bsgrubs pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs pa yin te/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/ la las de nyid rin chen sna bdun dang*// la las de bzhin zangs dang mkhar ba las// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas na// de dag thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni// sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci song ba// de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyis// lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid thob/ ces sogs dang*/ sgyu 'phrul las/ sa la sogs la phyag (494)rgyar byas// rnam grol rim pa thob gyur na// dag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyangs pas// smos ci dgos te de nyid yin/ zhes sogs phan yon rgya cher gsungs pa la yid ches kyis bsgrubs pa'i rten de yang zhal bsro ba dang*/ mnga' dbul ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya ba'i brdas dge zhing bkra shis par byed pa la/ pra tiṣ+ṭha bi dhi zhes rab gnas kyi cho gar yongs su grags pa ste/ he ru ka galpor/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la// ye shes bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs can// 'khor ba 'byung ba lnga yi gzugs// sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid yin/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje bkod pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la// mtha' yas grol ba'i rgyu yi phyir// rgyal ba dgug dang gzhug par bya/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bsgrub pa la shes byed kyi gzhi/

rang bzhin rten dang dgos pa dang*// slob dpon gnas su cho ga'o/ zhes phun sum tshogs pa'idagos pa rnams tshang ba'i dbang du byas nas/ gnyis pa ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la'ang*/ dkyil 'khor las rim (495)yo byad bshams// sgrub mchod dbu bzlas sbyangs bkru phyi// rten bskyed spyan drangs ched dgug gzhugs// rgyas gdab dbang bskur mchod bstod sngags// gtor ma snyan gsan mchod bstod dang*// bzod gshegs rten dgab lhag gnas sdom/ zhes sbyor ba sta gon du bya ba dang*/ bdag mdun sgrub mchod sbyangs bkru phyi// gsol gdab rten bskyed spyan drangs la// dgug cing rgyas gdab dbang bskur bya// mchod bstod spyan sogs dbye rten bsgyur// brten bzhugs mnga' rnam bzhi'o/ zhes dngos gzhi cho ga'i sdom tshig dang*/ gtor ma srung sgo mchod bstod dang*// nongs bshags sbyin sreg bsdu ldang dang*// yon bdag bsgo zhing rten la mchod// dga' ston bsngo smon shis pa brjod/ zhes rjes kyi bya ba ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul rnams las 'dir yon bdag bsgo ba zhes bya ba de'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ khyed kyi nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji (496)ltar gsungs par rab gnas par// de dag don ni nges bya te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyis// ci bde bar ni mchod par byos// gus dang sri zhu yang dag gyis// yon gnas mchog la bsnyen bskur ba'i// bsod nams dag ni brjod mi langs// rnam par gzigs la sran dog bdun// phul bas gzhon nu nga las nu// 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal gyur la ltos// de bzhin ston pas 'jam dpal la// nga ni 'khor ni rnam bzhi yis// da lta nga la mchod byas dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na dad pa yis// gzugs brnyan rnams ni mchod pa la/ khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// bsod nams mnyam zhing rnam smin mnyam/ zhes gsungs snying la yang dag zungs/

zhes gsungs pa dang*/ khyod kyi nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa legs par tshang bar byas kyis/ khyed kyis rten 'di la zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rgyun ma chad par gyis shig ces bsgo ba bzhin (497)du khyed kyis kyang dang du blang ba'i tshul du/ 'di ltar bshams pa'i mchod pa 'dis mtshon/ dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rab 'byams su spel ba 'dus pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig pas zhal bsro'i tshul du 'bul bar zhu/

zhes brda sbyar nas/ thams cad kyis zhwa chos bcas/ thams cad stong nyid = sogs kyis mchod pa byin rlabs/ gzhung gi 'jig rten khams ni dpag med= sogs nas brjod skabs las rdor nas mchod yon sogs rim par sbyin bdag la gtad/ sbyin bdag nas 'bul tshul byas pa las rdor gyis rten drung du bzhag bzhin/ shab+ta 'i mthar rol mo bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi shwa badz+ra sogs dang*/ sum+bha ni ba rjod cing rol mo dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ sbyin bdag mdun gro snod bzhag las sngags dang*/ swa bha ba/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams so so'i byed las las grub pa'i rnam pa dang*/ yon bdag kyang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon dzaṃ bha lar gyur/ zhes dang*/ gzhung gi sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs nas (498) mtshams sbyar rnams slob dpon gyis gsungs/ tshigs bcad rnams sdebs 'don dang rol mo bcas re re bzhin bya ba las/ rtsa 'tshong bkra shis kyi tshab tu/ bram ze kuṇ+ḍa lis rtsa durba zhes rnying lugs mdo dbang dang mthun par kha bsgyur ba las gzhan rnams 'dra/ rdzas rnams rten la 'bul tshul byas nas der 'khod thams cad la reg bcing yon bdag la gtad/ de bzhin du/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs kyi sku mtshan gyi me tog la dpe byad kyi ze'u 'brus brgyan pa'i yon tan gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i mthus/ dbu la gdugs kyi bkra shis/ spyan la gser nya'i bkra shis/ ljags la pad+ma'i bkra shis/ mgul la bum pa'i bkra shis/ thugs la dpal be'u'i bkra shis/ sku la rgyal mtshan gyi bkra shis/ gsung la dung gi bkra shis/ phyag zhabs la 'khor lo'i bkra shis rnams byung ba de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rtags brgyad kyis rdzas la brten nas shin tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig gzhung gi bkra shis gang zhig sa ོgas dang*/

de bzhin du/ gang yang bsod nams chen po'i dpal dang ldan pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po gang du byung ba (499)na de nyid phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i go 'phang la dbang bskur ba'i yo byad thun mong ma yin pa ni rin po che sna bdun yin la/ de yang 'khor lo la sogs pa bdun re re la yang rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan bdun dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yon tan bdun dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi yon tan bdun dang*/ chos kyi yon tan bdun rnams dang ldan te/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i dge legs chen po'i dpal gyis deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs sems can thams cad rin po che sna bdun gyi rdzas la brten nas shin tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ zhes dang*/ gzhung gi lha rdzas las byas= sogs nas dmag dpon yan rdzogs nas/ rol mo bya/ ston mchog dam pa= sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas= bsod nams ri bo= bgegs rigs stong phrag= lo brgya 'tsho zhing= sbyin pa gtong zhing= gnas 'dir nyin mo= sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku ni= sogs dang*/ yongs khyab shog zhes dang*/ (500)'byung po gang dag= 'dir ni rgyal= deng 'dir= sogs dang*/ rol mo sbir/ de nas rten la mchod pa ni/ me tog dam pa= sogs sh+lau ka gnyis dang*/ rol mo bya/ zhwa chos bzhag dga' ston bya ba ni/ las rdor gyis phyag gsum/ tshogs drangs ba'i tshig dang*/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ gsol zhing sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ zhais brjod cing*/ tsā ru'i bza' ba/ 'o thug tshogs dang bcas pa slob dpon 'dus pa sbyin bdag bcas la drangs te rol/ slob dpon nas mtshams sbyor cung zad dang bcas te gzhung gi bsngo ba/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i= sogs nas/ 'dus pa rnams nas mthun 'gyur mdzad cing*/ phun sum tshogs par gyur cig zhes dang*/ 'og gi

ston pa 'jig rten khams su= sogs nas gzhan yang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi= sa la 'og min= thub bstan mdzes pa'i= snga 'gyur bstan pa= bkra shis phan bde'i= bkra shis rgyal ba= bslab pa gsum ldan= phan bde'i 'byung gnas= dkon mchog rin chen gsum la= sogs nas thob par shog zhes dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa= sogs nas bho ta na ye swa ha 'a'i bar brjod do/ de nas las gzhung gang la brten pa'i (501) bsngo smon dang*/ bkra shis/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' bar tshom bu gcig tu tshogs pa'i smon lam gyis mtha' rgyan no/ de dag ni rab gnas nyin gsum ma ji ltar bya ba'i las rim bstan zin to/ de las kyang spros pa rgyas pa nyin lnga tsam bya na/ nyin dang por dkyil 'khor gang la brten pa'i bdag bskyed mdor bsdus rjes sgrub khog ltar sa chog lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon tsam dang*/ chag chag gdab nas ras bris bting*/ rgyan 'god dang*/ mchod pa byin brlabs tsam zin nas/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun sgrub mchod/ bum bzlas/ bdag 'jug sbyong ba nas sta gon nyin gcig dang*/ nyin gnyis pa dngos gzhi ji lta ba las/ brtan bzhugs gsol gdab/ phyogs bcu na tshar gnyis rjes/ phyi chog las byang mdor bsdus dang*/ bum bzlas/ bdag 'jug rig me dor/ sbyong ba nas/ s+t+wa gon bzhin tshang bar btang*/ nyin gsum bar de ltar snga gro dngos gzhi/ phyi gro sta gon/ sbyin sreg sa slong*/ nyin bzhi par dngos gzhi ji lta ba bzhin la/ phyi gror mnga' 'bul/ rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg 'o thug sgrub/ tsā ru'i zhal zas 'bul ba sogs bya/ nyin lnga par/ gong du bshad pa'i nyin gsum pa'i rjes chog dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bcas ji lta (502) ba bzhin bgyis pas grub bo/ 'bring po nyin gnyis ma bya na/ sta gon nyin gcig dang*/ dngos gzhi chos skyong gtor chog cha gsum dang bcas pa'i rjes su/ srung ma bsgo ba man sbyar ba dang*/ bsdus pa nyin chog ma bya na/

sta gon gyi dbang la slebs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i dbang la 'jug de phyin chad nyin gnyis ma ltar la 'bring bsdus gnyis la sbyin bsreg kyang dor ba yin no/ de las spros pa bsdu na 'brum gsum ma bya na gzhung ltar ro/ gzhung bzang gser gyi mchod sdong la// zur 'debs g.yu yi khra tshom gyis// spras 'di snga 'gyur bstan pa'i btsas// gyur nas kun la sman gyur cig /bdag kyang skye dang tshe rabs su// mtsho skyes bla ma'i rjes zhugs nas// snga 'gyur nang rgyud sde gsum gyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin gyur cig zhes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs a ra ga'i gzhung gsar rnying gnyis ka'i lugs 'gro don phyogs med du mdzad pa la 'dir re zhig gsar ma'i tshig ris rnams dor nas he ru ka galpo sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma'i lugs kho na gtso bor bzung*/ snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung dri ma med pas zur brgyan te snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan srog rgyal (503) dbang dpal yul ba'i nyams bzhes su snga 'gyur rig 'dzin chen po kun bzang shes rab kyi dbon rigs snga 'gyur ba'i bstan 'dzin mkhan rin po che 'jam dpal rdo rje dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du snga 'gyur ba'i bstan la zhugs pa grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma nor bu'i mtshan gyi cod pan bla dwags su 'chang ba dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan pa rin po che sgo kun nas phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ dge'o//
